articles.title: AI Should Create New Human Opportunities, Not Just Replace Human Jobs
articles.excerpt: Rethinking Artificial Intelligence Through Human Capability, Everyday Life, and Shared Prosperity Much of today's conversation about artificial intelligence focuses on one question: How much human lab…
articles.body: Rethinking Artificial Intelligence Through Human Capability, Everyday Life, and Shared Prosperity The Question We Should Be Asking About AI Much of today's conversation about artificial intelligence focuses on one question: How much human labor can AI replace? Can it automate customer service? Write code faster? Reduce operational costs? Replace repetitive tasks? Help companies operate with fewer employees? These are legitimate questions. Automation can improve productivity, reduce tedious work, and make services more accessible. But if we evaluate AI primarily by how much human labor it eliminates, we may be overlooking a much larger opportunity. What if AI could also create new human opportunities that did not exist before?

According to Drupal, attackers can still take over some sites, including production sites, even after that first fix. Drupal says attackers are already using this new flaw in the wild. articles.title: Pull Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby and Workday jobs into a CSV with Python
articles.excerpt: If you are building a jobs board, a recruiting alert, or a dataset of who is hiring, the hard part is usually not "call an API." It is that every company career site speaks a different ATS: Greenhouse…
articles.body: If you are building a jobs board, a recruiting alert, or a dataset of who is hiring, the hard part is usually not "call an API." It is that every company career site speaks a different ATS: Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, Recruitee, SmartRecruiters, or Workday. You end up writing a parser per platform, then keeping it working when a board URL changes. This tutorial shows how to get a single CSV of open jobs — title, company, ATS, location, remote flag, salary range, and apply URL — in about 40 lines of Python. It uses hosted actors on the Apify Store published by data_factory_nerd . You do not need an ATS API key or a login on any career site. You need an Apify account and its API token.

articles.title: Stake DAO minted 5.4 trillion tokens from one deployer key
articles.excerpt: On May 27, 2026, someone minted 5.4 trillion vsdCRV on Arbitrum. By the time it was over, they had extracted about $91,000. Five point four trillion tokens, ninety-one thousand dollars out. That ratio…
articles.body: On May 27, 2026, someone minted 5.4 trillion vsdCRV on Arbitrum. By the time it was over, they had extracted about $91,000. Five point four trillion tokens, ninety-one thousand dollars out. That ratio is the whole story, and it is worth understanding before the next one. What actually gave way Stake DAO's voting-escrow derivative used a LayerZero OFT bridge between Arbitrum and Ethereum. That bridge has a peer configuration: each side names the contract it trusts on the other side. The attacker did not break LayerZero. They did not forge a signature. They took the protocol's Arbitrum deployer key and used it to reset the peer configuration to an address they controlled. From then on, the bridge was listening to them.

articles.title: December full moon 2026: When, where and how to see the Cold Moon
articles.excerpt: Your guide to December's full Cold Moon, from peak times to skywatching highlights.
articles.body: The December full moon reaches peak illumination at 8:28 p.m. EST on Dec. 23 (0128 GMT on Dec. 24) as the lunar disk shines opposite the sun in Earth's sky. It is often called the "Cold Moon" in reference to the frigid temperatures that prevail in the Northern Hemisphere around the time of its rising, according to the Old Farmer's Almanac . December's full moon will also occur close to perigee — the moon's closest point to Earth in its elliptical orbit — giving rise to a spectacular supermoon. A supermoon can appear 30% brighter and 14% larger than a full moon at its farthest point from Earth (also known as a micromoon)..
